story: Outside-keyper path, end to end. The third keyper published only its round public keys with Merkle proofs (keyper export-pk); the board sealed to it with `exam --outside`, checking every key against that keyper's on-chain pkRoot, and never held its secrets. Threshold 3 of 3, so the paper could not open without it. Honest label: this outside keyper is a test account we run ourselves; no other team has joined yet. An earlier attempt the same afternoon (0x74c361d3) released 6 minutes late because the laptop hosting all three daemons went to sleep; its record says so.

timeline.step: outside keyper: setup + bond on v2, export-pk --hours 48 (public keys only)
createExam (keys of all three keypers verified against on-chain pkRoot) + addCentre x3
before the bell: open attempt refused, locked 0/3
bell 17:15:00 UTC: all three keypers release round 338

releases.keyper: test outside keyper (0xcbC4…3bF6) — run by us from its own home folder; the board only ever saw its public key file

timeline.step: centres decrypt; receipts name the paper hash
